class EvalStatus(str, Enum):
    PENDING = "PENDING"
    RUNNING = "RUNNING"
    COMPLETED = "COMPLETED"
    FAILED = "FAILED"
    TIMEOUT = "TIMEOUT"
    CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"

    @classmethod
    def terminal_statuses(cls) -> set["EvalStatus"]:
        return {cls.COMPLETED, cls.FAILED, cls.TIMEOUT, cls.CANCELLED}
